headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.32
summary: Two fixes for the new friend search: the press highlight now stays inside the row you tap instead of drawing a circle over it, and the keyboard closes when you submit a search or pick a result. Landscape no longer opens the fullscreen keyboard editor.

items.text: Pressing a search result drew a borderless ripple centred on the row and spilling outside it. The row now uses a bounded rounded ripple, so the highlight stays inside the person you touched.

Submitting a search left the keyboard open and, in landscape, Android replaced the screen with the fullscreen keyboard editor. The search field now suppresses the extract editor and dismisses the keyboard when you press Search, tap a result or switch tabs.
